Floods
in Kenya
Flooding across Kenya continues to take a devastating toll, Kenya Red Cross Society is tracking the impacts of flooding across 39 counties as of May 2026. Response teams have been mobilized on the ground to reach the most affected communities.  Over 26 million early warning SMS alerts have been dispatched to at-risk communities across the country. Currently, over 60,000 households have been affected across the country and more than 12,700 have been displaced.

Public Health in Emergencies
The Health, Nutrition, and Social Services (HSS) Department Focuses on primary health care; the most efficient and cost-effective way to achieve universal health coverage through a gender-responsive, protective, and inclusive lens.
Key Thematic Areas
Our work in emergencies is focused on two thematic areas;
Primary Health Care for Refugees and Host communities; running health facilities for primary health care services with minimal secondary services in Kalobeyei (part of larger Kakuma) and IFO (Dadaab).
Community Epidemic and Pandemic Preparedness especially on disease outbreaks. The society has been a champion of One Health and supported capacity at the community level but also enhanced collaboration with counties monitored through a community-based health information system (CBHIS). Within the organisation's national preparedness plan, KRCS has effectively responded to human and animal disease outbreaks including Cholera, Rift Valley Fever, Yellow Fever, and Kala-azar (Leishmaniasis).
